Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1255126 (Protein Mdm4). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL values. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
